baseState.general:
First-generation organoplatinum antineoplastic agent
Given intravenously (IV)
Highly effective but has significant toxicity
baseState.mechanism:
Forms DNA cross-links (intra-strand)
Inhibits DNA replication and transcription
Leads to cell apoptosis
baseState.clinical:
Testicular cancer (very important)
Ovarian cancer
Bladder cancer

baseState.general:
Third-generation organoplatinum antineoplastic agent
Less nephrotoxic and ototoxic than cisplatin
Commonly used in combination regimens (e.g., FOLFOX)
baseState.mechanism:
Forms DNA cross-links (intra-strand)
Inhibits DNA replication and transcription
Leads to cell apoptosis
baseState.sideEffects:
Peripheral neuropathy
Nausea and vomiting
Myelosuppression
baseState.clinical:
Colorectal cancer (main indication)
Used in regimens like:
FOLFOX
